# @crownone/ui — full usage reference

> Shared React Native / Expo component library for Crown One apps: themed components (light and dark mode), grouped lists, wallet formatters, a theme system with translatable built-in text, and typography tokens. iOS, Android and Web.

This file is the complete, version-matched reference for writing code that uses `@crownone/ui`. It ships inside the npm package at `node_modules/@crownone/ui/llms-full.txt`, so it always matches the installed version. The TypeScript definitions in `node_modules/@crownone/ui/lib/typescript/` are the final word on prop types.

## Rules

1. Import everything from the package root: `import { StyledButton, useTheme } from "@crownone/ui"`. Never import from `@crownone/ui/lib/...` or `@crownone/ui/src/...`.
2. The app must be wrapped in `ThemeProvider`, and the Inter fonts must be loaded under the exact names below. Components read colors from the theme and render with the wrong colors or fonts otherwise.
3. Never hardcode colors. Read them from `useTheme().colors`. Use `theme.spacing`, `theme.radius` and `CONTAINER_PADDING` for spacing.
4. Use the library's primitives instead of React Native's: `StyledText` instead of `Text`, `StyledImage` instead of `Image`, `StyledButton` instead of `TouchableOpacity` buttons, `StyledIcon` for icons.
5. `StyledIcon` and `StatusCard.iconName` use **MaterialCommunityIcons** names (`"check-circle"`, `"alert-outline"`, `"chevron-right"`). Ionicons names such as `"checkmark-circle"` will not render.
6. To size a `StyledButton` in a layout (for example `flex: 1` in a row), use `containerStyle`, not `style`.
7. Reject/Approve pairs: Reject is `variant="danger"` on the left, Approve/Confirm is `variant="success"` on the right, inside `<BottomActionsBar layout="row" gap={12}>` with `containerStyle={{ flex: 1 }}` on each button.
8. `BottomActionsBar` is `position: absolute` at the bottom by default (`sticky`). Pad the scroll content behind it, for example with `onHeight`. With `layout="column"`, pass `align="stretch"` or the children shrink to their content width.
9. Always pass `variant` to `StatusCard`. Its default is `"error"`.
10. Form fields: pass react-hook-form's `formState.errors` straight to `errors` with the field's `formKey`, and the message shows under the field. Both are optional.
11. Empty lists: use `EmptyListComponent`, never a hand-built `StatusCard variant="info"` with a "no record" message.
12. Money: use `formatCashWallet(value)` ("PKR 12,500") and `formatPointsWallet(value)` ("12,500 PTS"). Never concatenate "PKR" or "PTS" by hand.
13. Apps in other languages pass translations once through `ThemeProvider`'s `strings` prop (see Translations). Don't hardcode English inside shared components.

## Installation

```bash
npm install @crownone/ui
npx expo install @expo/vector-icons expo-blur expo-image expo-linear-gradient react-native-reanimated react-native-safe-area-context react-native-size-matters
```

Requirements: React >= 18, React Native >= 0.73, Expo SDK >= 50.

## Setup

### Fonts (iOS and Android)

Load Inter under these exact family names before rendering any component. On web the family is `"Inter"`; load it with a web font.

```tsx
import { useFonts } from "expo-font";

const [loaded] = useFonts({
  inter_light: require("./assets/fonts/Inter-Light.ttf"),
  inter_regular: require("./assets/fonts/Inter-Regular.ttf"),
  inter_medium: require("./assets/fonts/Inter-Medium.ttf"),
  inter_semiBold: require("./assets/fonts/Inter-SemiBold.ttf"),
  inter_bold: require("./assets/fonts/Inter-Bold.ttf"),
});
if (!loaded) return null;
```

### ThemeProvider

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@crownone/ui";
import { useColorScheme } from "react-native";

export default function App() {
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  return <ThemeProvider dark={scheme === "dark"}>{/* app */}</ThemeProvider>;
}
```

`ThemeProvider` props: `dark?: boolean` (use the built-in dark theme), `theme?: AppTheme` (a custom theme; takes precedence over `dark`), `strings?: Partial<UIStrings>` (translations for built-in text).

### Translations

Components render a few words of their own ("Cancel", "OR", "No record found", status titles…). English is the default. Pass translations once:

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider } from "@crownone/ui";
import { useTranslation } from "react-i18next";

const { t } = useTranslation();
<ThemeProvider
  dark={isDark}
  strings={{
    cancel: t("CANCEL"),
    selectPlaceholder: t("SELECT"),
    or: t("OR"),
    errorTitle: t("ERROR"),
    warningTitle: t("WARNING"),
    infoTitle: t("INFO"),
    successTitle: t("SUCCESS"),
    tapForDetails: t("TAP_FOR_DETAILS"),
    noRecordFound: t("NO_RECORD_FOUND"),
    shareReceipt: t("SHARE_RECEIPT"),
  }}
>
```

`UIStrings` is the type of the full object, `defaultStrings` holds the English defaults, and `useStrings()` reads the active strings inside the provider.

## Theme

```ts
import { useTheme } from "@crownone/ui";
const theme = useTheme(); // AppTheme
```

`AppTheme`:

- `dark: boolean`
- `colors`: `primary`, `primaryPressed`, `primarySoft`, `secondary`, `background`, `backgroundSecondary`, `backgroundTertiary`, `surface`, `surfaceSecondary`, `card`, `border`, `borderSoft`, `text`, `textSecondary`, `textMuted`, `textInverse`, `icon`, `placeholder`, `success`, `successSoft`, `warning`, `warningSoft`, `danger`, `dangerSoft`, `info`, `infoSoft`, `overlay`, `shadow`, `tabIconDefault`, `tabIconSelected`, `statusBar` (`"dark-content" | "light-content"`)
- `spacing`: `xs` 4, `sm` 8, `md` 12, `lg` 16, `xl` 24, `xxl` 32
- `radius`: `xs` 6, `sm` 10, `md` 14, `lg` 18, `xl` 24, `pill` 999

Use the `*Soft` colors for tinted backgrounds and the matching strong color for text, icons and borders on them (for example `successSoft` background with `success` icon).

Custom theme: spread a built-in theme and override only what you need.

```tsx
import { lightTheme, ThemeProvider } from "@crownone/ui";
import type { AppTheme } from "@crownone/ui";

const brandTheme: AppTheme = {
  ...lightTheme,
  colors: { ...lightTheme.colors, primary: "#6200EE", primaryPressed: "#3700B3", primarySoft: "#EDE7F6" },
};

<ThemeProvider theme={brandTheme}>{/* app */}</ThemeProvider>;
```

Other exports:

- `lightTheme`, `darkTheme`: the built-in `AppTheme` objects.
- `colors`, `palette`: raw color tokens behind the themes. Prefer `useTheme().colors` in components so dark mode works.
- `fontStyles`: the typography styles behind `StyledText` variants. `FONT_FAMILIES`: `light`, `regular`, `medium`, `semiBold`, `bold`.
- `CONTAINER_PADDING` (16): standard screen padding. `RADIUS` (8): base radius used by the components.

## Components

### StyledText

Text with the library's typography and theme colors. Accepts all React Native `Text` props.

- `variant`: `heading1Bold` (36) … `heading6Bold` (20), each also `…Regular`; `bodyLargeBold` / `bodyLargeRegular` (18), `bodyMedium…` (16), `bodySmall…` (14), `bodyXSmall…` (13), `bodyXXSmall…` (11).
- Shortcuts: `h1`–`h6`, `p` (body medium regular), `small` (body small regular), `mini` (body xsmall regular), `bold`, `primary` (primary color).
- `textColor`: a theme color key (`"textMuted"`, `"success"`), a palette key, or any color value.

```tsx
<StyledText variant="bodyMediumBold">Order summary</StyledText>
<StyledText small textColor="textMuted">Order #CR-10421</StyledText>
<StyledText h4>Welcome</StyledText>
```

### StyledImage

Image built on `expo-image`, with a loading indicator and a fallback image. Accepts all `expo-image` `ImageProps`.

- `source` (required), `placeholderSource?` (shown on error), `loaderColor?`, `style?`.

```tsx
<StyledImage
  source={{ uri: user.avatarUrl }}
  placeholderSource={require("./assets/default-avatar.png")}
  contentFit="cover"
  style={{ width: 80, height: 80, borderRadius: 40 }}
/>
```

### StyledButton

Themed button with variants, loading state, a press animation and a built-in double-tap guard (presses within 500 ms of the last one are ignored). It gets an automatic `testID` of `btn_<title>` unless you pass `testID`.

- `title: string` (required), `onPress?`
- `variant?`: `"primary"` (default) | `"outline"` | `"light"` | `"success"` | `"danger"` | `"info"`
- `loading?`, `disabled?`, `rounded?` (pill shape), `leftIcon?`, `rightIcon?`
- `containerStyle?`: layout of the outer wrapper (use this for `flex`, width, margins). `style?`, `textStyle?`, `textColor?`: the button body and label. All style props accept arrays.
- `testID?`

```tsx
<StyledButton title="Submit" onPress={submit} loading={isSubmitting} />

<BottomActionsBar layout="row" gap={12}>
  <StyledButton title="Reject" variant="danger" onPress={reject} containerStyle={{ flex: 1 }} />
  <StyledButton title="Approve" variant="success" onPress={approve} containerStyle={{ flex: 1 }} />
</BottomActionsBar>
```

When a submit handler awaits something before the API call (location, permissions), keep your own `isSubmitting` state set at the top of the handler and pass `loading={isSubmitting || isMutationLoading}`, so the button shows loading from the first tap.

### StyledCard

Themed surface card. It becomes pressable when `onPress` is set.

- `children` (required), `style?`, `onPress?`, `isPressable?` (default `true`; set `false` to keep the card static even with `onPress`).

```tsx
<StyledCard onPress={() => router.push("/receipt")}>
  <StyledText variant="bodyMediumBold">Pressable card</StyledText>
</StyledCard>
```

### StyledCheckbox

- `value: boolean` (required), `onChange?: (value: boolean) => void`, `disabled?`, `style?`.

```tsx
<StyledCheckbox value={accepted} onChange={setAccepted} />
```

### StyledRadioButton

Visual radio indicator only. Wrap it in a `Pressable` to handle presses.

- `isSelected: boolean` (required), `isDisabled?`.

```tsx
<Pressable onPress={() => setMethod("cash")} style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 12 }}>
  <StyledRadioButton isSelected={method === "cash"} />
  <StyledText p>Cash wallet</StyledText>
</Pressable>
```

### StyledChip

Label chip for statuses and filters.

- `label: string` (required), `variant?`: `"default"` (default) | `"selected"` | `"primary"` | `"outline"` | `"light"` | `"success"` | `"warning"` | `"danger"` | `"info"`
- `size?`: `"lg"` (default) | `"sm"`, `selected?`, `onPress?`, `chipStyle?`, `textStyle?`.

```tsx
<StyledChip label="Approved" variant="success" size="sm" />
<StyledChip label="Active" selected={filter === "active"} onPress={() => setFilter("active")} />
```

### StyledIcon

MaterialCommunityIcons icon with the theme's icon color by default.

- `name: string | undefined` (required, MaterialCommunityIcons name), `size: number` (required), `color?`, `style?`.

```tsx
const theme = useTheme();
<StyledIcon name="check-circle" size={24} color={theme.colors.success} />
```

### StyledTextField

Text input with label, left icon, password toggle and inline form errors. Accepts all `TextInput` props.

- Value: `text?` or `value?`. Changes: `setText?` (a state setter or `(value: string) => void`) and/or `onChangeText?`
- `label?`, `placeholder?`, `icon?` (element on the left), `withPasswordToggle?` (with `secureTextEntry`), `disabled?`, `marginVertical?`
- `formKey?` + `errors?`: shows the message for `formKey` under the field. `errors` is react-hook-form's `formState.errors` or `{ [formKey]: message }`
- Gets an automatic `testID` of `input_<label or placeholder>` unless you pass `testID`
- `containerStyle?`, `inputStyle?`, `searchFunc?` (called on submit)

```tsx
<StyledTextField label="Full name" text={name} setText={setName} />

// react-hook-form
<Controller
  control={control}
  name="email"
  render={({ field }) => (
    <StyledTextField
      label="Email"
      text={field.value}
      setText={field.onChange}
      keyboardType="email-address"
      formKey="email"
      errors={errors}
    />
  )}
/>
```

The input has a fixed `lineHeight` of 20 (so Urdu fallback fonts don't stretch the field). If you enlarge the text through `inputStyle` (`fontSize`), raise `lineHeight` with it, or tall glyphs are clipped.

### StyledDropdown

Cross-platform select: native action sheet on iOS, modal list on Android and Web. Generic over the value type.

- `items: DropdownItem<T>[]` (required; `{ label, value, disabled? }`), `value: T | null | undefined` (required), `onChange: (v: T) => void` (required)
- `formKey?` + `errors?`: same as `StyledTextField`
- `label?`, `placeholder?` (default from `strings.selectPlaceholder`), `disabled?`, `errorText?` (forces an error message), `inputStyle?`, `rightAdornment?`

```tsx
const countries: DropdownItem<string>[] = [
  { label: "Pakistan", value: "PK" },
  { label: "United Kingdom", value: "GB" },
];

<Controller
  control={control}
  name="country"
  render={({ field: { value, onChange } }) => (
    <StyledDropdown items={countries} value={value} onChange={onChange} placeholder="Select country" formKey="country" errors={errors} />
  )}
/>
```

### StyledTabs

Segmented tabs with optional count badges. Named export (not default). Generic over the tab key.

- `tabs: TabItem<Key>[]` (required; `{ key, label, badge? }`), `activeKey: Key` (required), `onTabChange: (key: Key) => void` (required)
- `style?`, `tabStyle?`, `textStyle?`, `activeTabStyle?`, `activeTextStyle?`

```tsx
type TabKey = "received" | "sent";
const tabs: TabItem<TabKey>[] = [
  { key: "received", label: "Received", badge: 3 },
  { key: "sent", label: "Sent" },
];
<StyledTabs tabs={tabs} activeKey={tab} onTabChange={setTab} />
```

### StatusCard

Tinted message card for errors, warnings, info and success. Named export (not default).

- `variant?`: `"error"` (default) | `"warning"` | `"info"` | `"success"`. Always pass it.
- `message?`, `description?`, `title?` (overrides the default title), `iconName?` (MaterialCommunityIcons)
- `clickable?` + `onPress?` + `hintText?`, `style?`

```tsx
<StatusCard variant="warning" message="Low balance" description="Top up to keep redeeming rewards." />
<StatusCard variant="info" message="Verification pending" clickable hintText="Tap for details" onPress={openKyc} />
```

### AlphabetAvatar

Circle with the first letter of a name.

- `name: string` (required), `size?`, `style?`.

```tsx
<AlphabetAvatar name={shop.name} size={46} />
```

### LoadingComponent

Activity indicator that renders only while `loading` is true.

- `size: "small" | "large"` (required), `loading?`, `color?`, `style?`.

```tsx
<LoadingComponent loading={isFetching} size="large" color={theme.colors.primary} />
```

### FieldError

Small danger-colored error line. Renders nothing when `message` is empty.

- `message?: string`.

```tsx
<FieldError message={errors.mobile?.message} />
```

### OrDivider

Horizontal divider with a centered label.

- `label?: string` (default from `strings.or`, "OR").

### Skeleton

Pulsing placeholder block. Set its size, radius and `backgroundColor` through `style`.

- `style?`, `duration?` (pulse duration in ms).

```tsx
const { colors } = useTheme();
<Skeleton style={{ width: "80%", height: 14, borderRadius: 4, backgroundColor: colors.backgroundTertiary }} />
```

### BottomActionsBar

Blurred action bar pinned to the bottom of the screen, respecting the safe area.

- `children` (required)
- `layout?`: `"row"` (default) | `"column"`; `gap?` (10); `align?` (`"center"`); `justify?` (`"center"`)
- `sticky?` (true: absolutely positioned at the bottom), `respectSafeArea?` (true), `showTopEdge?` (true), `intensity?` (blur, 50)
- `horizontalPadding?` (16), `verticalPadding?` (8), `style?`, `contentStyle?`, `onHeight?: (h: number) => void`

```tsx
const [barHeight, setBarHeight] = useState(0);

<ScrollView contentContainerStyle={{ paddingBottom: barHeight }}>{/* content */}</ScrollView>
<BottomActionsBar onHeight={setBarHeight} layout="column" align="stretch" gap={12}>
  <StyledButton title="Share receipt" variant="outline" onPress={share} />
  <StyledButton title="Done" onPress={done} />
</BottomActionsBar>
```

### BlurModalBackdrop

Blurred, tappable backdrop for modals. Use it inside a transparent `Modal`.

- `children` (required), `onPress?` (backdrop tap, usually close), `contentStyle?`.

```tsx
<Modal visible={visible} transparent animationType="fade" onRequestClose={close}>
  <BlurModalBackdrop onPress={close} contentStyle={{ justifyContent: "center", padding: 24 }}>
    <View style={{ backgroundColor: theme.colors.surface, borderRadius: theme.radius.lg, padding: 18 }}>
      {/* modal content */}
    </View>
  </BlurModalBackdrop>
</Modal>
```

### SearchBar

Search input with an icon. Accepts `TextInput` props except `value` / `onChangeText`, which are replaced.

- `value: string` (required), `setValue: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string>>` (required), `onChangeText?`, `placeholder?`, `containerStyle?`, `inputStyle?`.

```tsx
const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
<SearchBar value={search} setValue={setSearch} placeholder="Search shops" />
```

### EmptyListComponent

The standard "No record found" message for empty lists (an info `StatusCard`).

- `message?` (default from `strings.noRecordFound`), `isLoading?` (renders nothing while true), `style?`.
- It has no built-in margin. If the parent has no horizontal padding, pass `style={{ marginHorizontal: CONTAINER_PADDING }}`.

```tsx
<FlatList data={items} renderItem={renderItem} ListEmptyComponent={<EmptyListComponent isLoading={isLoading} />} />
```

### SummaryValueCard

Small tinted card with a title and a value, for totals and balances.

- `title: string` (required), `value: string` (required), `variant` (required): `"sent"` | `"received"` | `"success"` | `"warning"` | `"danger"` | `"info"`, `style?`.

```tsx
<View style={{ flexDirection: "row", gap: 10 }}>
  <SummaryValueCard title="Old cash wallet" value={formatCashWallet(oldBalance)} variant="info" />
  <SummaryValueCard title="New cash wallet" value={formatCashWallet(newBalance)} variant="success" />
</View>
```

### DateGroupedList

`SectionList` that groups items by date, with sticky headers showing the date and an item count.

- `items: T[]`, `getDateKey: (item) => string | number | null | undefined` (any date-parseable value), `keyExtractor`, `renderItem` (all required)
- `dateFormat?` (dayjs format, default `"dddd, DD-MMM-YYYY"`), `loading?`, `refreshing?`, `onRefresh?`, `emptyText?`, `ListHeaderComponent?`, `ListFooterComponent?`, `contentContainerStyle?`

```tsx
<DateGroupedList
  items={transactions}
  getDateKey={(tx) => tx.createdAt}
  keyExtractor={(tx) => String(tx.id)}
  renderItem={({ item }) => <TransactionRow item={item} />}
  refreshing={isFetching}
  onRefresh={refetch}
/>
```

### AlphabetGroupedList

`SectionList` that groups items A–Z by the first letter of a name, with sticky letter headers and counts.

- `items: T[]`, `getNameKey: (item) => string | null | undefined`, `keyExtractor`, `renderItem` (all required)
- `loading?`, `refreshing?`, `onRefresh?`, `emptyText?`, `ListHeaderComponent?`, `ListFooterComponent?`, `contentContainerStyle?`

## Hooks and utilities

- `formatCashWallet(value)`: `"PKR 12,500"`. `formatPointsWallet(value)`: `"12,500 PTS"`. Both accept `number | string | null | undefined` and treat invalid values as 0.
- `useSinglePress(handler, delay = 500)`: returns a stable press handler that ignores repeat presses within `delay` ms. Use it for any `Pressable` / `TouchableOpacity` you build yourself.
- `getFieldErrorMessage(errors, key)`: reads a field's message from react-hook-form `errors` or a `{ key: message }` map. `FormErrors` is the type the form components accept.
- `useStrings()`, `defaultStrings`, `UIStrings`: see Translations.

## Optional entry points

These need extra native modules, so they live in their own entry points. Apps that don't import them don't need the modules.

### @crownone/ui/receipt

Needs `react-native-view-shot` and `expo-sharing` (`npx expo install react-native-view-shot expo-sharing`).

`ShareableReceipt` renders a fixed-color receipt (same in light and dark mode) that can be captured as a PNG. `useShareReceipt()` returns `{ receiptRef, shareReceipt, isSharing }`. Render the receipt off-screen, attach `receiptRef`, and call `shareReceipt` from a button.

- `ShareableReceipt` props: `data: ShareableReceiptData` (required), `logo?` (image source shown in the header).
- `ShareableReceiptData`: `title`, `dateText`, `badge?`, `idLabel`, `idValue`, `fromLabel`, `from: { name, mobile }`, `toLabel`, `to: { name, mobile }`, `details?: { label, value, icon? }[]` (icon is an Ionicons name), `amountLabel`, `amountText`, `disclaimer`.

```tsx
import { ShareableReceipt, useShareReceipt } from "@crownone/ui/receipt";

const { receiptRef, shareReceipt, isSharing } = useShareReceipt();

<View style={{ position: "absolute", top: 0, left: -2000 }} pointerEvents="none">
  <ShareableReceipt ref={receiptRef} logo={require("./assets/logo.png")} data={receiptData} />
</View>
<StyledButton title="Share receipt" variant="outline" onPress={shareReceipt} loading={isSharing} disabled={isSharing} />
```

### @crownone/ui/otp

Needs `input-otp-native` (`npm install input-otp-native`).

`OtpBoxInput`: one box per digit, built on `input-otp-native`. Props: `value: string`, `onChange: (value: string) => void`, `maxLength?` (default 6). Forwards a ref (`OTPInputRef` from `input-otp-native`) for `focus()` / `clear()`.

```tsx
import { OtpBoxInput } from "@crownone/ui/otp";

<OtpBoxInput value={otp} onChange={setOtp} />
```

## TypeScript exports

`AppTheme`, `AppColors`, `UIStrings`, `FormErrors`, `StyledButtonProps`, `StyledButtonVariant`, `StyledChipVariant`, `StatusCardVariant`, `DropdownItem`, `TabItem`, `SkeletonProps`, `DateSection`, `AlphabetSection`. From `@crownone/ui/receipt`: `ShareableReceiptData`, `ShareableReceiptProps`, `ReceiptParty`, `ReceiptDetailRow`.

```ts
import type { AppTheme, DropdownItem, TabItem } from "@crownone/ui";
```
